facts.title: grilled eggplant and olive pizza
ingredients: 1 pound store-bought pizza or homemade pizza dough at room temperature (1 1/2 of this recipe will yield a 1-pound dough)
5 ounces sliced provolone, cut into short thin matchsticks (1 1/4 cups)
Handful pitted green olives, coarsely chopped (1/3 cup)
facts.yield_text: Makes 4 hearty dinner servings, or 9 appetizer-size portions
facts.author: Deb Perelman
